qa.questionFormat: Can I order Iceland - Easton delivery in South West, UK with Uber Eats?

qa.questionFormat: How do I order Iceland - Easton delivery online in South West, UK?
qa.answerFormat: There are 2 ways to place an order on Uber Eats: on the app or online using the Uber Eats website.
